title: On local integrability results for $p$-adic reductive groups
summary: We present a short proof, based on local character expansions, of the celebrated theorem of Harish-Chandra about local integrability of complex characters of $p$-adic reductive groups. The proof gives an algebraic incarnation of the local integrability that works for some coefficients different from $\mathbb{C}$, verifies local integrability in cases that appear not covered in the literature, and shows that a character is locally-$L^α$ for some specified $α>1$ as in [GGH23].
